_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your real values. Never share config.json once it has your API key in it.

device._comment: Fill these in from `npm run list-devices`

twitch._comment: Register a free app at https://dev.twitch.tv/console/apps — see README.md for exact steps. authPort is a local-only port used once for the login redirect; it doesn't need to be open to the internet.

idleScene._comment: Optional. If set, the lamp returns to this scene after an alert's revertAfterMs elapses. Leave paramId/id as 0 to disable reverting entirely.
idleScene.name: Idle

scenes._comment: Fill these in from `npm run list-scenes`. Each key below is a Twitch event. Set revertAfterMs to 0 to leave the scene running instead of reverting.
